### Local WiNET module (recommended)

The integration talks directly to the stove's WiNET module (configurable LAN IP):
full state, fire level 0-5, fan speed 1-6, flue temperature, pellets low, weekly
program, alarms with explicit messages. Automatic cloud fallback when the module
is unreachable.
This integration brings WiNET Wi-Fi pellet stoves (Thermorossi, and other
brands on the thermorossi.cloudwinet.it / cloudwinet.it portal) into Gladys
Assistant.

## What it does

One device per stove, with the features the stove has: on/off (thermostat
mode), air setpoint (5 to 40 °C), heating state, room temperature sensor,
state in words (standby, ignition, working, cleaning, alarm…), an alarm
binary sensor and the power level select (1 to 5). Scenes can also trigger on
the `stove_alarm` event, once per alarm.

## Prerequisites

- A WiNET stove that works in the Thermorossi Connector app (portal
  https://thermorossi.cloudwinet.it).
- Gladys Assistant 5.1 or later.

## Setup

1. Install the integration from **Integrations** in Gladys.
2. In the **Configuration** tab, enter the WiNET portal e-mail and password,
   then click **Test the connection**: the stove state is shown.
3. Open the **Discovery** tab and create the stove.

The integration talks to the WiNET cloud over the Internet, never to the
stove directly: the stove must be online in the app. Credentials stay in the
Gladys configuration (secret field); the device API key, scraped from the
portal like the app does, is kept in the integration data volume and
re-scraped automatically when the cloud refuses it.

## Troubleshooting

- “WiNET portal login failed”: check the credentials; a new attempt is
  retried automatically every 15 minutes.
- The cloud returns 0 °C temperatures while the stove is off: the integration
  then publishes the mode and state only, never a fake temperature.
- The WiNET module keeps a single active session: if the official app is
  open at the same time, command conflicts are possible.

Unofficial community integration, not affiliated with Thermorossi or
NetSoftware.

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que Thermorossi WiNET te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | Use the e-mail and password of the Thermorossi WiNET portal (the same account as the Thermorossi Connector app). The integration reads your device's API key from the portal, exactly like the app does, then talks to the WiNET cloud. Unofficial integration, no affiliation with Thermorossi or NetSoftware. |
| Portal e-mail | `string` | Sí |  |
| Portal password | `secret` | Sí |  |
| Stove name (optional) | `string` | No | Name shown in Gladys. Leave empty to use the name declared on the portal. |
| Stove WiNET module IP (LAN) | `string` | No | Direct local read/write on the stove's WiNET module — exposes everything (fan speed, flame level, flue temperature, detailed alarms). Leave empty to use only the WiNET cloud (reduced data). |
| Labels language | `select` | No |  |
| Refresh interval (s) | `number` | No | How often the stove is read, in seconds (one minute minimum, to stay courteous with the cloud). |

## Cómo instalar Thermorossi WiNET en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: Thermorossi WiNET aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/tchoinard38/gladys-winet:1.2.2`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/tchoinard38/gladys-winet](https://github.com/tchoinard38/gladys-winet).

Thermorossi WiNET requiere Gladys `>=5.1.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

Thermorossi WiNET es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [tchoinard38](https://github.com/tchoinard38), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
